allowPermissionsDesc: Iyo bishobojwe, MCP ibikoresho vyose bizokwerekanwa ata kwerekana ibiganiro vy'uruhusha. Iyi nzira irakoreshwa kw’isi yose ku biganiro vyose, harimwo n’ibiganiro bishasha.

runtimeSettings.title: Amagenamiterere ya Runtime
runtimeSettings.description: Kugena uko Novera ikoresha no gusubiramo seriveri MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Igihe kinini cyo gutegereza kugirango MCP igikoresho gisubizo mbere yo kurenga igihe.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Icyo ari cyo cyose kirenze iki gikurikiraho gihindurwa kandi kigashyirwaho nk'icyahindutse, kugirango umusaruro umwe muto utagira icyo uhindura ku murongo wa model. Gushyiraho kuri 0 kugirango uhindure ibisubizo byose.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Ryari: Bikora, Novera itoranya MCP seriveri bifitanye isano mbere yo gufungura ibikoresho. Gufunga kugirango gufungura buri gihe i MCP urutonde rw'ibikoresho.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Gukoresha a model yihariye yo guhuza
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Igihe inzira y’ubwenge iriko irakora, genda intambwe y’inzira n’ikigereranyo gitandukanye (kenshi gito) aho gukoresha ikigereranyo c’uguserukira. Zima kugira ngo wama ukoresha uburyo bwo kuvugana bukora kugira ngo ukoreshe inzira.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Guhitamo umucuruzi n'ubwoko bwa telefoni mu mwanya umwe.Ibikoresho bito gusa nibyo bigaragara mu rutonde.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Amamodoka make ntaboneka. Kongeramo amamodoka make cyangwa configure API key in Models.
